Record high revenue and operating margin (EBITA)
STOCKHOLM , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
President and CEO Aritz Larrea comments: "We delivered a strong third quarter, with record-high revenue, operating income (EBITA) and operating margin (EBITA %). The consistent execution of our strategic priorities continues to drive growth and profitability across the business. Both segment USA and segment Europe and Latin America contributed to the performance, supported by strong demand for secure logistics and the management of high-value assets, as well as cash-handling automation solutions. Revenue exceeded SEK 8 billion, with currency-adjusted growth of 6.6 percent, while our EBITA margin increased by nearly two percentage points yearâoverâyear to 15.1 percent.
We are well positioned to continue to invest in long-term growth opportunities, pursue value-creating acquisitions, and deliver attractive shareholder returns."
Revenue for the quarter was SEK 8,161 million (7,644). The currency-adjusted growth was 6.6 percent (7.1), of which organic growth was 5.8 percent (3.9) and acquisitions contributed 0.8 percent (3.2). Including the exchange rate effect, the total growth was 6.8 percent (0.3).
Operating income (EBITA) 1) for the quarter was SEK 1,229 million (1,006) and the operating margin (EBITA) increased to 15.1 percent (13.2).
Operating income (EBIT) before items affecting comparability for the quarter was SEK 1,177 million (961) and operating margin (EBIT) before items affecting comparability was 14.4 percent (12.6).
Items affecting comparability during the quarter totaled SEK â24 million (â23), related to restructuring in the Europe and Latin America segment.
Income before taxes for the quarter was SEK 986 million (789) and net income for the period was SEK 690 million (528).
Basic earnings per share for the quarter were SEK 10.31 (7.80) and diluted earnings per share were SEK 10.26 (7.77).
Cash flow from operating activities 2) was SEK 732 million (978) in the quarter. Cash flow from operating activities for the rolling twelve months was 84 percent (95) of operating income (EBITA).
Net debt in relation to EBITDA was 1.52 times (1.65) in the quarter.
Loomis expanded its presence in Latin America through the acquisitions of Transportadora del Interior in Argentina in July and Hermes Transportes Blindados in Peru in October.
1) Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Amortization of acquisition-related intangible fixed assets, Acquisition-related costs and revenue and items affecting comparability.
2) Cash flow from operating activities is exclusive of impact from IFRS 16.
